title: Day Counter
description: Count days between two dates and see the difference in weeks and approximate months.
metaDescription: Count days between two dates online, with an option to include start and end dates.

form.title: Count days
form.description: Choose two dates to see the difference in days, weeks, and approximate months.

seo.about: The counter calculates the difference between two dates in days and shows approximate equivalents in weeks and months.
seo.howToUse: Select the start and end date. Enable inclusive counting when you want to count both dates in the period.
